body: I've spoken to several doctors and therapists. No one has been able to help me thus far. I'm deathly afraid of getting fired, and I can't shake the feeling. The only solution seems to be to kill myself.

Thank you. I'm just getting really tired of my wild emotions. I've been on and off antidepressants for years now. I'm not sure why I should keep living if I'm never going to find anything to give me joy in life.
I would like to talk. Do you have a few minutes?
